text: Q4-Preview Create Task POST https://api.vidu.com/ent/v2/reference2video [图标] Subjects-Reference to Video Headers Authorization string * No description Example: Token Body parameters model string * Model name，Accepted values: viduq4-preview viduq4-preview: Supports generating videos with reference sound; supports intelligent camera switching, achieves superior consistency across multiple camera positions; supports simultaneous audio and video output. Allowed values: viduq4-preview prompt string * A textual description for video generation. Note 1: The length cannot exceed 20000 characters. Note 2: Use [@subjects_name] to represent subject content. For example: "@1 and @2 are eating hot pot together, and the narrator says that everyone loves hot pot." images array * Multiple images are supported. The model will generate a video with a consistent subject by referring to the subject in the images passed through this parameter. The specific requirements are as follows: Note 1: viduq4-preview model supports uploading 1 to 15 images; Note 2: Image Base64 encoding or image URL (ensure accessibility) is supported for input. Note 3: Images support png, jpeg, jpg and webp formats. Note 4: Please note that the POST body of an HTTP request shall not exceed 20MB, and the encoding must include an appropriate Content-Type string, for example:data:image/png;base64,{base64_encode} sounds array Up to 0 to 3 audio files are supported for upload, and the model will generate a video with a consistent subject based on the audio passed in this parameter. Note 1: The duration of each reference audiorange 3-12s. Note 2: The audio supports mp3 format. Note 3: The size of each audio file shall not exceed 50M. Note 4: The post body of the http request shall not exceed 20MB, and the encoding must contain an appropriate content type string, for example:data:video/mp3;base64,{base64_encode} audio boolean Whether to use the audio-video output capability. true: Use the audio-video output capability. false: Do not use the audio-video output capability. Default: true Allowed values: true false duration integer Video duration parameter Default: 5 Allowed values: 3 - 16 aspect_ratio string Aspect ratio parameter. Default: 16:9 Allowed values: 1:1 9:16 16:9 3:4 4:3 resolution string Resolution parameter Default: 720p Allowed values: 540p 720p 1080p 2K 4K seed integer Random seed When not passed or passed as 0, a random number will be used instead. When manually set, the set seed will be used. Default: 0 payload string Transparent transmission parameters. No processing, only data transmission. Note: Maximum of 1048576 characters. callback_url string Callback protocol When creating a task, you need to actively set the callback_url with a POST request. When the video generation task changes its status, Vidu will send a callback request to this URL, containing the latest status of the task. The structure of the callback request content will be the same as the return body of the Query Task API. The "status" in the callback response includes the following states: processing: Task is being processed. success: Task is completed (if sending fails, it will retry the callback three times). failed: Task failed (if sending fails, it will retry the callback three times). Vidu uses a callback signature algorithm for verification. See Callback Signature for details. Response 200 OK application/json Response fields task_id string Task ID generated by Vidu state string Processing state, accepted values: created created successfully queueing task in queue processing processing success generation successful failed task failed model string The model name used for this call prompt string The prompt parameter used for this call images string The image parameter used for this call duration integer The video duration parameter used for this call seed integer The random seed parameter used for this call aspect_ratio string The aspect ratio parameter used for this call resolution string The resolution parameter used for this call payload string The transparent transmission parameter passed in this call credits integer The credits consumed by this call created_at string Task creation time Q4-Preview Query Creations GET https://api.vidu.com/ent/v2/tasks/{id}/creations [图标] Headers Authorization string * No description Example: Bearer Path parameters id string * Task ID. Returned by the Create Task API upon successful creation. Response 200 OK application/json Response fields Expand all id string Task ID state string * Processing state, accepted values: created created successfully queueing task in queue processing processing success generation successful failed task failed err_code string Error code, see the error code table for details credits integer The number of credits consumed by this task payload string The payload (pass-through) parameter passed in for this task call [图标] creations array Generation results id string Generation ID, used to identify different creations url string Creation URL, valid for 24 hours cover_url string Creation cover, valid for 24 hours watermarked_url string Watermarked creation URL, valid for 24 hours
